system.description:
Standing in the thick of a fight doesn't rattle you the way it does most spellcasters.

  • You have Advantage on Fortitude saves made to keep a spell you are casting, or to maintain concentration on one, when you take damage.
  • You can perform the somatic components of spells while holding weapons or a shield in one or both hands.
  • Choose one type of Light or Medium armour, or a shield: you are trained in it, so wearing it does not block your casting.
  • (If your class is already trained in it, this last benefit adds nothing.)

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.
